UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private user account profile and monthly spending goal settings for Orby.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

username.description: Display username chosen at registration or synced from Google profile.

monthlyGoal.description: Optional monthly spending target in BRL (0 or null means no goal set).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Individual monthly expense record (single or part of an installment plan) owned by a user.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the expense owner.

amount.description: Positive BRL value for this expense or installment.

type.description: Whether the expense is recurring fixed or variable.

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used for the expense.

installmentGroupId.description: Shared identifier linking all monthly installments of a purchase.

installmentTotal.description: Total number of installments in the purchase (2..60).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the expense was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the expense was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private profile document and preferences for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Private subcollection of monthly expenses and installment records owned by the user.
